mechanism.claim: Within a completed volatile eight-hour BTC auction, same-direction aggressive demand that is led by perpetuals in the first four hours but led by spot cash in the second four hours identifies a leverage-to-cash transfer of price sponsorship. Follow the transferred cash-flow direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of the four normalized aggressive-flow fractions
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCPMR moves spot quote-turnover participation and requires price confirmation. HVSFLR measures a static final-two-hour spot/perpetual flow-magnitude ratio. HVLCFH instead requires an ordered two-half reversal of cross-venue aggressive-flow dominance with one persistent flow sign and uses no price direction, funding, OI, premium, or volume-share migration.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual path variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset 03/11/19 UTC ordered cross-venue flow-handoff onsets are absent from Gross9

features.block: 480 exact aligned coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT spot and perpetual rows [D-8h,D), split into two exact 240-minute halves
features.normalized_flow: (2*sum(taker_buy_quote)-sum(quote_asset_volume))/sum(quote_asset_volume) separately by venue and half; positive finite denominator and strict nonzero flow required
features.persistent_sign: all four half-by-venue normalized flows have one strict sign s
features.handoff_strength: minimum of the two strict absolute-flow dominance gaps
features.handoff_rank: strict-prior midrank of handoff_strength over at most 270 source-valid positive handoffs, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 480 perpetual log(close/open) minute returns)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full rule true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: natural global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_handoff_tail: ordered handoff plus variation and onset without strength rank
definitions.one_block_stale_handoff: prior block handoff with current variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent ordered leverage-to-cash aggressive-flow sponsorship transfer

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, flow normalization, block, half, dominance, rank, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
